name: Baleful Mastery
oracle_text:
You may pay {1}{B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {1}{B} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card.
Exile target creature or planeswalker.
blocked_sentences: You may pay {1}{B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost
If the {1}{B} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card

needs.what: an unconditional cheaper alternative mana cost on an instant or sorcery whose payment is readable by a condition while the spell itself resolves, so an `if` inside `spell_effects` can say "if the {1}{B} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `evoke` is the unconditional alternative mana cost and `evoked` is its condition, but resolve_top (engine/stack.py) writes `obj.cast_evoked = item.evoked` only AFTER `spell_effects` run (it is meant for a permanent's enters trigger), and EffectContext carries no evoked flag -- so on an instant the `evoked` condition always reads False and the opponent would never draw. `cast_overloaded`, `cast_cost_option` and `cast_from_graveyard` are set before the effects, but none of them records an alternative cost. `alternative_cost` (card-level) records no flag at all and requires a condition when the price is mana only. `cost_option` belongs to `additional_cost_options`, an additional cost, not a replacement for the mana cost.
